summary: Incident queue and triage endpoints: list incidents (optionally filtered by status), fetch one with its correlated timeline and MITRE ATT&CK context, and `PATCH` its status through OPEN, INVESTIGATING and RESOLVED. Status changes require the `WRITE` dependencies from `deps.py` and are broadcast over SSE through `iip/live.py`; serialisation comes from `iip/queries.py`.
